sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:14

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:14:1
items.html: The very body of Malchut is made of the Gevurot called BON, which were extended through the posterior of ZA; but her actual Nefesh, etc., at the time of the first Zivug: That is, the Katnut of Malchut, which is the essence of her building, as is known, is made of the lights of BON that were extended to her through the hole in the posterior of the Chazeh of ZA, as he wrote in its place. But her actual Nefesh — that is, her Gadlut, that she be fit to give birth to souls, namely, the discernments of the vessel that raises the MAN and of the Ruach within the vessel, as above — this is given to her at the first intercourse, as explained above.
